name: squid-flowing-water
comment: WP-2.3 (squid in a current): EntitySquid.isInWater's handleMaterialAcceleration push (EntitySquid.java:67-69; a query with a side effect, transcribed vanilla bug) with a non-zero flow vector. A stone channel (floor y = 59, x -1..11, z -1..1; walls at y = 60 on z = -1, z = 1, x = -1, x = 11) gets a flowing-water source (id 8, meta 0) at (0, 60, 0) at t=0; it spreads along +x (metas 1..7 at x = 1..7) by about t=40. At t=50 two squids are spawned in the current (x = 3.5 and 5.5, y = 60, z = 0.5): every tick EntityLiving.onLivingUpdate's isInWater (EntityLiving.java:627) adds the 0.014 push along the flow before moveEntityWithHeading, and EntitySquid.onLivingUpdate's own call (EntitySquid.java:85) adds it again before the swim motion is assigned (in water) or kept (out of water). No player; chunks within 3 preloaded. block_box of the channel at t=49 (the current's metas), rng_state and entity_state of all every tick.
